input.summary: Add express performance warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy and carve it out of the AS-IS disclaimer
input.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly "AS IS" with no affirmative warranty or remedy, which is our walk-away position; we have added a limited conformance and workmanlike-performance warranty with a repair, replace or refund remedy and carved it out of the disclaimer. If helpful we can fall back to a 90-day software warranty period.
